# Assume previous variables still exist in environment? If not, refetch quickly.
# We'll refetch essentials to be safe.

def fetch_all(func, **kwargs):
    out=[]
    i=0
    while True:
        page = func(page_index=i, page_limit=20, **kwargs)
        if not page:
            break
        out.extend(page)
        i+=1
    return out

library_songs = fetch_all(apis.spotify.show_song_library, access_token=token)
liked_songs = fetch_all(apis.spotify.show_liked_songs, access_token=token)
downloaded_songs = fetch_all(apis.spotify.show_downloaded_songs, access_token=token)

album_library = fetch_all(apis.spotify.show_album_library, access_token=token)
liked_albums = fetch_all(apis.spotify.show_liked_albums, access_token=token)

downloaded_song_ids = {s['song_id'] for s in downloaded_songs}
liked_song_ids = {s['song_id'] for s in liked_songs}

keep_song_ids = liked_song_ids | downloaded_song_ids
remove_song_ids = [s['song_id'] for s in library_songs if s['song_id'] not in keep_song_ids]

liked_album_ids = {a['album_id'] for a in liked_albums}

# Album downloaded condition: all songs in it are downloaded
keep_album_ids = set()
remove_album_ids = []
for a in album_library:
    aid = a['album_id']
    liked = aid in liked_album_ids
    song_ids = a.get('song_ids') or []
    downloaded = all(sid in downloaded_song_ids for sid in song_ids)
    if liked or downloaded:
        keep_album_ids.add(aid)
    else:
        remove_album_ids.append(aid)

print('Counts:')
print('song_library:', len(library_songs))
print('liked_songs:', len(liked_songs))
print('downloaded_songs:', len(downloaded_songs))

print('remove_song_ids:', len(remove_song_ids))
print('album_library:', len(album_library))
print('liked_albums:', len(liked_albums))
print('keep_album_ids:', len(keep_album_ids))
print('remove_album_ids:', len(remove_album_ids))

# Verification tables
print('\nSongs to remove (song_id, title, album_title, liked?, downloaded?)')
for sid in remove_song_ids:
    song = next(x for x in library_songs if x['song_id']==sid)
    liked = sid in liked_song_ids
    downloaded = sid in downloaded_song_ids
    print(sid, song['title'], song.get('album_title'), liked, downloaded)

print('\nAlbums to remove (album_id, title, liked?, downloaded_all_songs?)')
for aid in remove_album_ids:
    a = next(x for x in album_library if x['album_id']==aid)
    liked = aid in liked_album_ids
    song_ids = a.get('song_ids') or []
    downloaded_all = all(sid in downloaded_song_ids for sid in song_ids)
    print(aid, a['title'], liked, downloaded_all)
